note: TECH01's shape on a 60 ms PCR (fixture_gen's v and a2, 5 ms of jitter): the usual level 300 ms, every 150 s from 100 s +200/+400 ms ramped over two seconds (a step, not a leap) for 12 s, then 200 ms under the usual level for 11 s (chapter 15.4 B-95). The first burst's envelope step (110.3 s) seeds the line on a late sample of the rise; the dip 500-600 ms under that seed is no backlog's floor on a step-seeded line, and every later burst is a 10 s run at the line, so the window rule never moves it: 1 relock, nothing dropped, the video lead median 598 -> 988 ms (the bursts' height). Before B-95: the dip moved the line and the usual level stepped again, the 150 s pairs: 12 relocks, 6.88 s dropped.
